title.zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon 模型

current_state.zh: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 4“Argon”，这是一款新的前沿模型，可通过 API 使用，入门价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元（缓存输入享 95% 折扣），因其 SVG 生成和自然语言写作质量而受到关注。
current_state.en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 'Argon', a new frontier model available via API at introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens (95% off cached input), drawing attention for its SVG generation and natural-language writing quality.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，称其为迄今最强大的模型
updates.title_en: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
updates.what_changed_zh:
谷歌于 2026 年 9 月 30 日（周三）发布 Gemini 4 Argon，将其宣传为迄今最强大的模型，并定位为面向编程与网络安全工作的主力模型。据 CNBC 报道，该模型首先面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴推出，而非全面开放。

这是谷歌在前沿模型竞争中的最新一次发布；据 CNBC 报道，其初始投放仅面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴，而非所有开发者。谷歌将其定位为开发者、专业人士与企业解决难题的伙伴。

谷歌博客称，Gemini 4 Argon 在编程、知识工作、网络安全防御和创意写作方面具备“前沿级能力”。第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将“Gemini 4 Argon (High)”列为智能水平领先的模型之一，并称其相对同类模型定价合理。
updates.what_changed_en: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.
updates.background_zh: 据 9to5Google 报道，Gemini 4 Argon 采用了新的命名体系，此前谷歌取消了 Gemini 3.5 Pro，并将重心放在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上。前沿模型通常基于海量数据训练，成本极高，涵盖数据获取与处理以及算力开支。第三方对比报道将 Gemini 4 Argon 与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 视为同代竞争对手。
updates.background_en: Gemini 4 Argon uses a new naming scheme and follows the cancellation of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with Google having focused on Gemini 3.8 Flash, according to 9to5Google. Frontier models are typically trained on vast datasets at very high cost, covering data acquisition and processing plus compute. Third-party comparison coverage places Gemini 4 Argon alongside OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as a same-generation rival.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。
updates.market_impact_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.

updates.title_zh: Google重回第一梯队：Gemini 4 Argon追平GPT-6 Astra
updates.title_en: Google重回第一梯队：Gemini 4 Argon追平GPT-6 Astra
updates.what_changed_zh: Artificial Analysis 的独立评估发现，谷歌的 Gemini 4 Argon 在智能指数上以 53 分与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，其幻觉率远低（15%），API 入门价格也更便宜，但全价成本和答案准确性落后于 Astra。
updates.what_changed_en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.
